latest_release.name: v3.3.5
latest_release.body: # v3.3.5 This version of Zoraxy fixed quite a lot of security related issues (due to recent flood of AI generated security advisories, which after manual review, some of them are true) with added features on Zoraxy Auth and HTTP/3 (QUIC) support. There are also significantly more PRs in this release due to (I think) much more improved agentic coding tools. Other than that, as usual, there are ACME / DNS providers update and some patches in fixing small bugs in Captcha and oAuth flow. Full summary below. ## What's Changed * Fix client IP detection for IPv6 clients in forward auth by @Elandrya2711 in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1264 * fix(ui): reload access rule lists when the tab is opened by @driin0 in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1261 * update lego: v5.4.0 by @zen8841 in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1273 * Update CHANGELOG.md by @Morethanevil in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1274 * Fix #1283 by @zen8841 in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1292 * fix: persist ACME preferred CA skipTLS setting (#1289) by @zen8841 in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1293 * V3.3.5-rc1 by @tobychui in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1291 * Feat/add recursive ns check gui by @zen8841 in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1296 * update lego to v5.5.0 by @zen8841 in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1300 * Add granular DNS-01 NS propagation check controls by @zen8841 in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1303 * fix: correct OAuth2 User Info URL field name casing by @Samet195 in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1309 * Add inbound HTTP/3 (QUIC) support by @milux in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1311 * V3.3.5-rc2 by @tobychui in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1317 * plugins: pass process PID to output readers (fixes data race #1326) by @BerziOnline in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1327 * Fix: resolve CAPTCHA client IP with the trusted proxy policy (#1321) by @yeungalan in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1328 * V3.3.5-rc3 by @tobychui in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1324 * Fix: carry Remember Me over the SSO gateway fast path (#1315) by @kenny-ish in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1331 * V3.3.5-rc4 by @tobychui in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1335 * Fix CVE-2026-111943 by @tobychui in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1341 * Feat: TLS cipher profile setting (Mozilla default/intermediate/modern) by @milux in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1314 * V3.3.5-rc5 by @tobychui in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1345 * build(deps): bump docker/login-action from 4.6.0 to 4.7.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1352 * Update supporters.txt by @tobychui in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1368 ## New Contributors * @Elandrya2711 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1264 * @Samet195 made their first contribution in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1309 * @milux made their first contribution in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1311 * @BerziOnline made their first contribution in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1327 * @kenny-ish made their first contribution in https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/pull/1331 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tobychui/zoraxy/compare/v3.3.4...v3.3.5
